docs/how-it-works.md:25:8. **Report.** For each request, pi-action posts a `🤖 pi Response` comment (or `❌ pi Error`), and adds 🚀 (or 😕) to the request. If pi gives an empty answer, pi-action asks one time for a summary. If a response hits the output token limit (`max_tokens`) without a tool call, pi-action asks pi to continue, up to 3 times in a row and within `timeout`, and then posts an error. In `output` mode, pi-action sets the `response` and `success` outputs and posts nothing.
docs/how-it-works.md:28:When a tool from a pi-durable extension asks a question, the run ends after step 7 without a `pi Response` comment. See [Questions on GitHub](extensions.md#questions-on-github).
docs/prompts.md:8:| **Follow-up** | Each later request on the thread: an `@pi` comment, or a `pr_number` run | `**@login** commented (<url>):` and the task. For a review comment: `commented on the diff`. pi-action adds the URL when it has one. Then the [reply reminder](#the-reply) |
docs/prompts.md:13:## The task
docs/prompts.md:15:The **task** is the text after the first occurrence of the trigger phrase, without spaces at the start and end. The match ignores case. For `@pi please review this`, the task is `please review this`.
docs/prompts.md:17:Before pi-action finds the task, it removes HTML comments and invisible characters from the text. It does the same to the title and the body of the issue or pull request (see [Security](security.md#what-pi-action-removes-from-text)).
docs/prompts.md:19:For a `pr_number` run, the task is `prompt`, or `Please review this pull request` when `prompt` is empty. For a direct prompt, the task is `prompt`.
docs/prompts.md:28:4. `## Task`: the task.
docs/prompts.md:33:For a direct prompt, the message has `# Direct pi Task`, the task, and the requirements block.

docs/threads.md:81:The conversation records which snapshot belongs to it, in a document that pi-action writes in the same commit as a `pi-action.worktree` entry. The model does not see the document or the entry. When the conversation is forked or rewound to an earlier entry, it gets the snapshot that was current at that entry.
